invariants: Only meter value expressions lose redundant Math.round(x * scale) / scale. All other JSX props, handlers, units, bounds, steps, precision, and all non-meter control attributes are byte-for-byte preserved.
scope: 178 literal meter value pre-rounding sites in 26 files. The existing wall panel uses a separate explicit meter/foot display-value path; it was audited but not part of this non-wall migration.
